svg.title: Мах ногой назад в наклоне — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing bent-over rear leg swing with fixed support, strictly side view. Athlete faces a simple stable waist-high bench and braces BOTH hands on it, chest inclined forward at hips, one supporting foot flat on floor. Left: moving leg almost straight with toes just above floor beneath hip. Right: that same almost-straight leg extends behind body, its foot raised to about hip height, while trunk angle, pelvis, both hands and supporting foot remain fixed. Motion originates at HIP, working knee remains nearly straight in both phases. No ankle weights, bands or cable. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
